permissionProfiles.label: No permissions
permissionProfiles.description: Deno receives no filesystem, network, environment, subprocess or FFI permissions.

permissionProfiles.label: Read test fixture
permissionProfiles.description: Configured Deno permissions: read /fixtures only (baked-in test file). Not general filesystem access.

permissionProfiles.label: Demo environment variable
permissionProfiles.description: Configured Deno permissions: env SANDBOX_DEMO_VALUE only. Application secrets are not injected.

permissionProfiles.label: Chat broadcast
permissionProfiles.description: Host capability chat.broadcast via Host Gateway. Deno may reach only the gateway; authority is enforced by the gateway, not by network access alone.

permissionProfiles.label: Approved host capabilities
permissionProfiles.description: Narrow SDK/Gateway transport. Only the version-bound approval snapshot grants host authority.
